items.en: We are pleased that you were invited to this ceremony.
I express my gratitude for your invitation.

items.uz: Bugungi kun tarixda alohida o'rin tutadi.
items.en: Today holds a special place in history.

items.uz: Bu yutuqqa erishish uchun ko'p mehnat qilindi.
items.en: A lot of work went into achieving this success.

items.uz: Men kelmoqchi bo'lgan edim, va mana, keldim.
items.en: I had intended to come, and here I am.

items.uz: Bu men aytmagan edimmi, hammasi yaxshi bo'ladi deb?
items.en: Didn't I say everything would be fine?

items.uz: Albatta aytgan edingiz, va haq chiqdingiz.
items.en: Of course you did say so, and you were right.
Let's achieve such successes again in the future.
I thank everyone and wish good luck.
This day will remain in our memory forever.
